# PR body — R6.16 (manifest 269 · RUNNER-CORE-c + RUNNER-SUPERVISION)

## What

`hh-runner` can now run experiment windows unattended and honestly: it packs
slots first-fit in the engine's recorded order under the C rule, supports the two
declared schedule kinds and their composition, applies each protocol's declared
reattempt policy through `ExperimentEngine` (never its own counter), stops
admitting at the dead-man cut-off while harvesting incrementally, sweeps only its
own labelled containers — and it supervises `hh-model-proxy` and
`hh-egress-mediator` as separate sole-writer processes over the Json control
channel, minting and revoking per-slot tokens, granting each cell exactly its
sealed-phase sockets, and carrying the proxy root pool forward from harvested
ledgers.

Two commits preserve the contract's stage boundaries:

- **`611dfd73` — Stage 1 (scheduling):** `crates/hh-runner/src/schedule.rs` +
  `coordinator::drive_window` + packet `window`/`podman_bin` members.
  `hh-runner-window/1` records the C inputs and `C`
  (`min(⌊(host−reserve)/slot_mem⌋, ⌊vcpu/slot_cpus⌋, ⌈K/f⌉ for agent phases)`),
  the `first_fit_recorded_order` packing rule with lookahead, the actual
  `start_order` with `in_flight_at_start`, `withheld{window_deadline|budget}` /
  `unresolved` sets, `blocks+1` catalog snapshots, and the `hh-runner-harvest/1`
  manifest ref — all blob-deposited into the experiment store. `declared_harvest_ms`
  is a required member (the ticket's "declared harvest time" is declared, never
  defaulted). Coupled O/H pairs launch in one packing step — admitted together or
  withheld together, never split. Engine remains sole scheduler/retry counter
  (`claim→launch→settle`; X-04): a retry gated past its window's end is
  `unresolved` (REQ-XH-125), never-attempted plans are `withheld`.
- **`1b9cdf44` — Stage 2 (supervision):** `crates/hh-runner/src/supervision.rs` +
  packet `supervision` member + drive integration. `ProxyCtl` speaks the proxy's
  Json stdio control channel (`configure` → `register_slot`/`revoke_slot`/
  `catalog_boundary`/`status`/`stop`); `MediatorProc` consumes the `ready`
  handshake and reaps the kill. `fold_prior_window` reimplements
  `harvest_window_spend` read-only (`hh-hosting` is unreachable for the runner,
  REQ-XC-101/CC1): `verify` + Σ `measurement.cost.attributed` + `proxy_aborted`
  at bounded-hi; `unharvested`/`unverified` refuse **before any process spawns**
  (X-02, no estimates). `slot_open` mints a fresh token per attempt and projects
  `cell_env_projection(model_port, token)` + sealed phase grants into the cell
  record; `slot_close` revokes at every close (X-05); `catalog_boundary` lands at
  `window_open` + each `block_end`. `finish_attempt` takes the fenced
  `acquire_writer` takeover when the launch-armed subject lease expired (a worker
  outliving the manifest writer TTL — a latent R6.8 fix).

## Deferral

**DF-R6.7-1 closed** — the cell-environment credential-confinement leg landed:
`credential_env` names the variable only the proxy resolves; the cell env carries
the per-attempt slot token — no member carries the upstream credential
(`r6_16b::ac9_supervised_drive_tokens_grants_and_credential_confinement`,
`r6_16::ac9_supervised_drive_end_to_end`). R6.10's receipt `leak_scan` leg
disposition is preserved in the append-only row.

## Deviation (recorded, AMEND)

~3.8k changed source/test lines vs ≤1700 (Stage 1 ≈2.1k + Stage 2 ≈1.8k) —
same recorded-deviation precedent as R6.8 (~5.3k via ADR-0427), R6.9, R6.10,
R6.11, R6.14. Run ledger + phase log carry the note; no new decision — no new ADR.

## Honest limits

- Mediator legs verify spawn/`ready`/kill; no bytes flow in the offline battery
  (its transport is R6.15-proven).
- `child_env` is the fixture seam for the credential env var; production inherits
  the runner env. The value never enters a record.
- No `hharness-hosting` dependency added; proxy reached as a process per
  REQ-XC-101.
